$schema_note: Frozen quality-gate thresholds for the manifold-discovery pipeline run on MaxToki-217M. Committed at Phase 0 per the pipeline's 'set before Phase 1, never loosen' rule. Source: pipelines/manifold-discovery-extraction-compactification.md sections 2 (Phase 2) and 7 (Parameters).
promotion_rules: A positive branch must pass ALL five gates on the internal panel before Phase 5 training proceeds.
A positive branch must pass ALL four gates on the strict non-overlap external panel before Phase 8.
The paired null branch MUST fail at least one of the four numeric gates with a margin (failure within rounding does not count).
Adjusting any gate threshold downward to make a failing branch pass is a forbidden pipeline violation. Such a violation invalidates the entire run.
All rescue operations must expand internal coverage (more donors, more cell types, more tissues). The external panel is read-only after Phase 1.

expected_negative_control_failure.why: Lung tissue has no hematopoietic developmental structure. If it passes the gates, the pipeline is detecting generic tissue covariance rather than the hematopoietic manifold.
